::: {.recipe-meta}
**Serves:** 8\
**Prep time:** 10 minutes\
**Cook time:** 1¼ hours

[Main]{.badge .badge-main} [Vegetarian]{.badge .badge-vegetarian}
:::

*A warm, vegetarian option for the winter.*

## Ingredients

- 1 lb frozen broccoli
- ½ cup butter
- 1 can cream of mushroom soup
- 1 can cream of chicken soup
- 1 jar of Cheez Whiz®
- 3–4 cups cooked rice

## Instructions

*Preheat the oven to 350°F.*

1. In a 6 quart casserole dish, melt the butter and cook the frozen broccoli until done.
2. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix thoroughly.
3. Bake for 1 hour.
